sermon.title: Six Aspects of Faith and Belief —April 11, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer traces six aspects of faith in the healing of the nobleman’s son. The man heard, came, and asked Jesus to come down, but Jesus simply said, “Go; your son lives.” He believed the word, learned the boy recovered that hour, and his whole house believed. God makes deserts blossom, and feelings don’t limit Him.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

scriptures.text_nkjv: But Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers; so the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments. For every man threw down his rod, and they became serpents. But Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.
Therefore by Him let us continually offer the sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of our lips, giving thanks to His name.

faqs.question: Was “no honor in his own country” overcome?
faqs.answer: Yes, he says that statement was overcome in this chapter.

faqs.question: Should we build our faith on one verse?
faqs.answer: No. Paul declared the whole counsel of God; we shouldn’t write people off either.

faqs.question: What can Satan do?
faqs.answer: Only lying wonders, and only what Father God allows.
